imerg_precip.name: mean precipitation rate over the month
imerg_precip.unit: mm h⁻¹ (× 24 × days in month = monthly total in mm)

imerg_error.name: random error of the merged satellite-gauge estimate (NASA's randomError)

imerg_gauge_weight.name: weight of rain gauges relative to the satellite estimate (gaugeRelativeWeighting)

imerg_quality.name: quality index of the precipitation field (precipitationQualityIndex)

imerg_liquid.name: accumulation-weighted probability that the precipitation was liquid (probabilityLiquidPrecipitation)
